technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 15ml, this KoColor POLISH is expertly formulated with Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Titanium Dioxide, Silica. Delivering a high-fidelity Canvas White color profile (`#F5F5F5`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
